title: Class
description: Technology-neutral definition of a character class in GUMFALL. The class spine is VERIFIED at 12 classes. Classes have a base level range of 1-12, specialty selection from Level 3, advancement features at Levels 4 and 8, a signature technique at Level 10, and a capstone at Level 12.

id.description: Unique identifier matching a VERIFIED canonical class id.

name.description: Human-readable display name matching VERIFIED canonical class name.

resource_name.description: Name of the class's primary resource pool.

identity.description: One to two sentence description of what defines this class's gameplay identity and fantasy.

specialties.description: VERIFIED specialty paths available from Level 3. Each class has multiple specialty options.

description.description: Brief description of this specialty's focus and playstyle.

level_features.description: Features gained at each class level. VERIFIED structure: base 1-12, specialty from 3, advancements at 4 and 8, signature technique at 10, capstone at 12.

level.description: Class level at which this feature is gained.

feature_name.description: Name of the feature or ability gained.

description.description: Mechanical and narrative description of the feature.

specialty_locked.description: True if this feature is only available to a specific specialty path.

specialty_id.description: If specialty_locked is true, which specialty this feature belongs to.

injury_fallback.description: How this class adapts when key body regions are injured or destroyed. Physical consequences must remain meaningful (Core Pillar 4).

exploration_utility.description: Description of how this class contributes in exploration, traversal, and non-combat scenarios.

party_role.description: Primary and secondary roles this class fulfills in group play.

solo_viability.description: Assessment of how well this class performs in solo play.

pvp_counterplay.description: Design notes on how opponents interact with and counter this class in PvP. Supports Core Pillar 11 (skill-first structured PvP).

description.description: Full narrative and mechanical description of this class.

notes.description: Internal design notes, authority labels, or open questions.
